parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The diameter of the cross-section of a long solenoid is $3.2\text{ cm}$, as shown in Fig. 9.1.

{{figure:figure_9_1}}

A coil C, with 85 turns of wire, is wound tightly around the centre region of the solenoid.

The magnetic flux density $B$, in tesla, at the centre of the solenoid is given by the expression

$$B = \pi \times 10^{-3} \times I$$

where $I$ is the current in the solenoid in ampere.

Show that, for a current $I$ of $2.8\text{ A}$ in the solenoid, the magnetic flux linkage of the coil C is $6.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Wb}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The current $I$ in the solenoid in (b) is reversed in $0.30\text{ s}$.

Calculate the mean e.m.f. induced in coil C.
